description: This script manages the review lifecycle for components by updating metadata.yaml files. It includes functions for starting, stopping, and clearing review cycles, and provides user guidance via help messages.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds and lists all components with metadata.yaml files excluding certain paths.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and lists available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves the path to component's metadata.yaml, verifying its existence.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a date after adding a specified number of business days.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Resets review lifecycle date fields in a YAML metadata file.
